title.en: Grammar: Sentence structure and Aaguperayar (தொடர் இலக்கணம், ஆகுபெயர்)

text.en: Sometimes a name is used for something connected to it.

ஆகுபெயர் is a word that, instead of meaning its own thing, denotes something closely related to it. For example, when we say 'the whole village came', ஊர் stands for the people of the village.
The main kinds are பொருளாகுபெயர், இடவாகுபெயர், காலவாகுபெயர், சினையாகுபெயர், பண்பாகுபெயர் and தொழிலாகுபெயர். The textbook also teaches how words join to make a sentence (தொடர்).
Practise identifying which type it is: a place name for its people is இடவாகுபெயர்; a time name for what happens in it is காலவாகுபெயர்; a part for the whole is சினையாகுபெயர்.
